gloss_en: I want to send an email to the manager now
notes: [tech] email→imiːl (Sudanic has no mid /eː/; nativisation projects to nearest [iː] — total nativisation, no drop). Khartoum frame داير 'wanting'/هسع 'now' (leddycecere2021; dickins2007). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I have an important meeting with a manager
notes: [work] meeting→miːtinɡ (/ŋ/→[nɡ]); manager→manadʒar (loan /dʒ/ stays [dʒ] — the loan phone is not merged to the native palatal ǧīm [ɟ]). table: default pan-Arabic

gloss_en: I downloaded a file but the download is slow
notes: [tech] file→fil; download→dawnlaud (/aʊ/→[aw]). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: laptop بِتَاعِي خَربَان وْ screen مَكْسُور
raw: laptop بتاعي خربان و screen مكسور
ipa: labtub biˈtaːʕiː xarˈbaːn w sriːn makˈsuːr
gloss_en: my laptop is broken and the screen is cracked
notes: [tech] laptop→labtub (/p/→[b]); screen→sriːn (/skr/ onset simplified). genitive exponent بتاعي (dickins2007). table: default pan-Arabic

gloss_en: I paid cash not card
notes: [commerce] cash→kaʃ; card→kaːrd. Sudanese ما-negation (dickins2007). table: default pan-Arabic

gloss_en: I saw the manager next to a garage
notes: [work] garage→ɡaːradʒ (final /ʒ/→[dʒ], [ɡ] onset in inventory — the Sudanic qaf reflex /q/→[ɡ]). native جنب → [ɟanb] shows Sudanese ǧīm [ɟ] (leddycecere2021 §3.1.1). table: default pan-Arabic

sentence: printer مَا شَغَّال وْ charger ضَايِع
raw: printer ما شغال و charger ضايع
ipa: brinta maː ʃaɣˈɣaːl w ʃaːdʒa ˈdˤɑːjiʕ
gloss_en: the printer does not work and the charger is lost
notes: [tech] printer→brintar (/p/→[b]); charger→ʃaːrdʒar (/tʃ/→[ʃ], loan /dʒ/ kept). table: default pan-Arabic

gloss_en: I watched a video at home today
notes: [daily] video→fidiu (/v/→[f]). KHARTOUM MONOPHTHONGISATION: Dickins (2007) has ay→[eː], aw→[oː], so بيت 'house'→[beːt], يوم 'day'→[joːm]; the spec does not carry the rule, so the pipeline keeps the diphthongs and emits 'ˈʃuft fidiu biˈlbajt aˈljawm'. Correct Khartoum form pinned with beːt/joːm. table: default pan-Arabic

sentence: نَشُوفَك weekend الجَّاي إِنْ شَاءَ الله
raw: نشوفك weekend الجاي إن شاء الله
ipa: naˈʃuːfak wiːkind alɟˈɟaːj ˈʔin ˈʃaːʔa ˈallah
gloss_en: we will see you next weekend, God willing
notes: [daily] weekend→wiːkind. native ج in الجاي → [ɟ] (Sudanese palatal ǧīm; leddycecere2021 §3.1.1). table: default pan-Arabic

gloss_en: I saw a new model at the showroom
notes: [automotive] model→mudil. native ج in جديد → [ɟ]; ض in المعرض → [dˤ] (interdental/emphatic series merged to stops; leddycecere2021 §3.1). table: default pan-Arabic

sentence: فِي offer كْوَيِّس وْ discount كْبِير
raw: في offer كويس و discount كبير
ipa: fiː ufa ˈkwajjis w disawnt ˈkbiːr
gloss_en: there is a good offer and a big discount
notes: [commerce] offer→ufar; discount→disawnt (/aʊ/→[aw]). frame كويس 'good' (Sudanese zone). table: default pan-Arabic

sentence: delivery مِتْأَخِّر وْ service مَا كْوَيِّس
raw: delivery متأخر و service ما كويس
ipa: dilifiri mitˈʔaxxir w safis maː ˈkwajjis
gloss_en: the delivery is late and the service is not good
notes: [commerce] delivery→dilifari; service→sarfis (/v/→[f]). table: default pan-Arabic

gloss_en: the car went for a service in the morning
notes: [automotive] loan سَرفِيس 'service (station)' → saˈrfiːs (/v/→[f]); attested car-register loan [sarfiːs] (Holes 2004). Pipeline reads the vocalised loan natively and matches. table: default pan-Arabic

gloss_en: I paid cash, there are no problems
notes: [commerce] loan كَاش 'cash' → kaːʃ, matches attested [kaːʃ]. ما في 'there isn't' (Sudanese negation; dickins2007). table: default pan-Arabic

gloss_en: the car has a puncture, I must fix it
notes: [automotive] loan بَنشَر 'puncture' (< Eng. puncture) → banʃar, matches attested [banʃar] (Holes 2004). table: default pan-Arabic

gloss_en: my mobile is lost
notes: [tech] loan موبايل 'mobile'; attested [moːbaːjil]. PIPELINE WRONG: emits 'almuˈːbaːjil' — reads و as [uː] not the loan mid vowel [oː] and misplaces stress inside the length mark. Correct loan IPA pinned. table: default pan-Arabic

gloss_en: I have a new television in the room
notes: [daily] loan تلفزيون 'television'; attested [tilifizjoːn]. PIPELINE WRONG: emits 'tilifiˈzjuːn' — reads و as [uː] instead of the loan mid vowel [oː]. Correct loan IPA pinned. table: default pan-Arabic

gloss_en: how are you man? I am fine
notes: [arabizi] Latin-script Sudanese (zol 'man/person', hallmark Sudanese lexeme). Spells كِيفَك يَا زُول؟ أَنَا تَمَام. The pipeline has no Arabizi path; ipa hand-derived as the Khartoum reading it spells, with monophthong ay→[eː] in keːfak (dickins2007). table: n/a

gloss_en: where did you go yesterday
notes: [arabizi] Latin-script Sudanese (7=ح/ħ). Spells وَين مَشَيت أَمْبَارِح. Pipeline has no Arabizi path; ipa hand-derived as the Khartoum reading, with monophthong ay→[eː] in weːn/maʃeːt (dickins2007). table: n/a

gloss_en: do you have anything new
notes: [arabizi] Latin-script Sudanese (3=ع/ʕ, 7=ح/ħ). Spells عِنْدَك حَاجَة جْدِيدَة. Pipeline has no Arabizi path; ipa hand-derived as the Khartoum reading, with ǧīm [ɟ] in ħaːɟa/ɟdiːda (leddycecere2021 §3.1.1). table: n/a
